column2: Yasalūnaka ʿani l-ʾanfāli quli l-ʾanfālu lillāhi walrrasūli fattaqū llāha waʾaṣliḥū dhāta baynikum waʾaṭīʿū llāha warasūlahu ʾin kuntum muʾminīn
ʾinnamā l-muʾminūna ladhīna ʾidhā dhukira llāhu wajilat qulūbuhum waʾidhā tuliyat ʿalayhim ʾāyātuhu zādathum ʾīmānan waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
Alladhīna yuqīmūna ṣ-ṣalawāta wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn
ʾūlāʾika humu l-muʾminūna ḥaqqan lahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfiratun warizqun karīm
Kamā ʾakhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bilḥaqqi waʾinna farīqan mina l-muʾminīna lakārihūn
Yujādilūnaka fi l-ḥaqqi baʿda mā tabayyana kaʾannamā yusāqūna ʾilā l-mawti wahum yanẓurūn
Waʾidh yaʿidukumu llāhu ʾiḥdā ṭ-ṭāʾifatayni ʾannahā lakum watawaddūna ʾanna ghayra dhāti sh-shawkati takūnu lakum wayurīdu llāhu ʾan yuḥiqqa l-ḥaqqa bikalimātihi wayaqṭaʿa dābira l-kāfirīn
Liyuḥiqqa l-ḥaqqa wayubṭila l-bāṭila walaw kariha l-mujrimūn
ʾidh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fastajāba lakum ʾanni mumiddukum biʾalfin mina l-malāʾikati murdifīn
Wamā jaʿalahu llāhu ʾillā bushrā walitaṭmaʾinna bihi qulūbukum wamā n-naṣru ʾillā min ʿindi llāhi ʾinna llāha ʿazīzun ḥakīm
ʾidh yughashshīkumu n-nuʿāsa ʾamanatan minhu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum mina s-samāʾi māʾan liyuṭahhirakum bihi wayudhhiba ʿankum rijza sh-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihi l-ʾaqdām
ʾidh yūḥi rabbuka ʾilā l-malāʾikati ʾanni maʿakum fathabbitū ladhīna ʾāmanū saʾulqi fi qulūbi ladhīna kafarū r-ruʿba faḍribū fawqa l-ʾaʿnāqi waḍribū minhum kulla banān
Dhālika biʾannahum shāqqū llāha warasūlahu waman yushāqiqi llāha warasūlahu faʾinna llāha shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
Dhālikum fadhūqūhu waʾanna lilkāfirīna ʿadhāba n-nār
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū ʾidhā laqītumu ladhīna kafarū zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumu l-ʾadbār
Waman yuwallihim yawmaʾidhin duburahu ʾillā mutaḥarrifan liqitālin ʾaw mutaḥayyizan ʾilā fiʾatin faqad bāʾa bighaḍabin mina llāhi wamaʾwāhu jahannamu wabiʾsa l-maṣīr
Falam taqtulūhum walākinna llāha qatalahum wamā ramayta ʾidh ramayta walākinna llāha ramā waliyubliya l-muʾminīna minhu balāʾan ḥasanan ʾinna llāha samīʿun ʿalīm
Dhālikum waʾanna llāha mūhinu kaydi l-kāfirīn
ʾin tastaftiḥū faqad jāʾakumu l-fatḥu waʾin tantahū fahuwa khayrun lakum waʾin taʿūdū naʿud walan tughniya ʿankum fiʾatukum shayan walaw kathurat waʾanna llāha maʿa l-muʾminīn
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū ʾaṭīʿū llāha warasūlahu walā tawallaw ʿanhu waʾantum tasmaʿūn
Walā takūnū kalladhīna qālū samiʿnā wahum lā yasmaʿūn
ʾinna sharra d-dawābbi ʿinda llāhi ṣ-ṣummu l-bukmu ladhīna lā yaʿqilūn
Walaw ʿalima llāhu fīhim khayran laʾasmaʿahum walaw ʾasmaʿahum latawallaw wahum muʿriḍūn
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū stajībū lillāhi walilrrasūli ʾidhā daʿākum limā yuḥyīkum waʿlamū ʾanna llāha yaḥūlu bayna l-marʾi waqalbihi waʾannahu ʾilayhi tuḥsharūn
Wattaqū fitnatan lā tuṣībanna ladhīna ẓalamū minkum khāṣṣatan waʿlamū ʾanna llāha shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
Wadhkurū ʾidh ʾantum qalīlun mustaḍʿafūna fi l-ʾarḍi takhāfūna ʾan yatakhaṭṭafakumu n-nāsu fāwākum waʾayyadakum binaṣrihi warazaqakum mina ṭ-ṭayyibāti laʿallakum tashkurūn
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū lā takhūnū llāha walrrasūla watakhūnū ʾamānātikum waʾantum taʿlamūn
Waʿlamū ʾannamā ʾamwālukum waʾawlādukum fitnatun waʾanna llāha ʿindahu ʾajrun ʿaẓīm
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū ʾin tattaqū llāha yajʿal lakum furqānan wayukaffir ʿankum sayyitikum wayaghfir lakum walllahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm
Waʾidh yamkuru bika ladhīna kafarū liyuthbitūka ʾaw yaqtulūka ʾaw yukhrijūka wayamkurūna wayamkuru llāhu walllahu khayru l-mākirīn
Waʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhim ʾāyātunā qālū qad samiʿnā law nashāʾu laqulnā mithla hādhā ʾin hādhā ʾillā ʾasāṭīru l-ʾawwalīn
Waʾidh qālū l-lahumma ʾin kāna hādhā huwa l-ḥaqqa min ʿindika faʾamṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratan mina s-samāʾi ʾawi ʾtinā biʿadhābin ʾalīm
Wamā kāna llāhu liyuʿadhdhibahum waʾanta fīhim wamā kāna llāhu muʿadhdhibahum wahum yastaghfirūn
Wamā lahum ʾallā yuʿadhdhibahumu llāhu wahum yaṣuddūna ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wamā kānū ʾawliyāʾahu ʾin ʾawliyāʾuhu ʾillā l-muttaqūna walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
Wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿinda l-bayti ʾillā mukāʾan wataṣdiyatan fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
ʾinna ladhīna kafarū yunfiqūna ʾamwālahum liyaṣuddū ʿan sabīli llāhi fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasratan thumma yughlabūna walladhīna kafarū ʾilā jahannama yuḥsharūn
Liyamīza llāhu l-khabītha mina ṭ-ṭayyibi wayajʿala l-khabītha baʿḍahu ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahu jamīʿan fayajʿalahu fi jahannama ʾūlāʾika humu l-khāsirūn
Qul lilladhīna kafarū ʾin yantahū yughfar lahum mā qad salafa waʾin yaʿūdū faqad maḍat sunnatu l-ʾawwalīn
Waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fitnatun wayakūna d-dīnu kulluhu lillāhi faʾini ntahaw faʾinna llāha bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīr
Waʾin tawallaw faʿlamū ʾanna llāha mawlākum niʿma l-mawlā waniʿma n-naṣīr

Waʿlamū ʾannamā ghanimtum min shāʾin faʾanna lillāhi khumusahu walilrrasūli walidhi l-qurbā walyatāmā walmasākīni wabni s-sabīli ʾin kuntum ʾāmantum billlahi wamā ʾanzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawma l-furqāni yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni walllahu ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīr

ʾidh ʾantum bilʿudwati d-dunyā wahum bilʿudwati l-quṣwā walrrakbu ʾasfala minkum walaw tawāʿadttum lakhtalaftum fi l-mīʿādi walākin liyaqḍiya llāhu ʾamran kāna mafʿūlan liyahlika man halaka ʿan bayyinatin wayaḥyā man ḥayya ʿan bayyinatin waʾinna llāha lasamīʿun ʿalīm
ʾidh yurīkahumu llāhu fi manāmika qalīlan walaw ʾarākahum kathīran lafashiltum walatanāzaʿtum fi l-ʾamri walākinna llāha sallama ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr
Waʾidh yurīkumūhum ʾidhi l-taqaytum fi ʾaʿyunikum qalīlan wayuqallilukum fi ʾaʿyunihim liyaqḍiya llāhu ʾamran kāna mafʿūlan waʾilā llāhi turjaʿu l-ʾumūr
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū ʾidhā laqītum fiʾatan fathbutū wadhkurū llāha kathīran laʿallakum tufliḥūn
Waʾaṭīʿū llāha warasūlahu walā tanāzaʿū fatafshalū watadhhaba rīḥukum waṣbirū ʾinna llāha maʿa ṣ-ṣābirīn
Walā takūnū kalladhīna kharajū min diyārihim baṭaran wariʾāʾa n-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli llāhi walllahu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭ

Waʾidh zayyana lahumu sh-shayṭānu ʾaʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumu l-yawma mina n-nāsi waʾinni jārun lakum falammā tarāʾati l-fiʾatāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla ʾinni bariʾun minkum ʾinni ʾarā mā lā tarawna ʾinni ʾakhāfu llāha walllahu shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
ʾidh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna walladhīna fi qulūbihim maraḍun gharra hāʾulāʾi dīnuhum waman yatawakkal ʿalā llāhi faʾinna llāha ʿazīzun ḥakīm
Walaw tarā ʾidh yatawaffā ladhīna kafarū l-malāʾikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum waʾadbārahum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīq
Dhālika bimā qaddamat ʾaydīkum waʾanna llāha laysa biẓallāmin lilʿabīd
Kadaʾbi ʾāli firʿawna walladhīna min qablihim kafarū biyāti llāhi faʾakhadhahumu llāhu bidhunūbihim ʾinna llāha qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
Dhālika biʾanna llāha lam yaku mughayyiran niʿmatan ʾanʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā biʾanfusihim waʾanna llāha samīʿun ʿalīm
Kadaʾbi ʾāli firʿawna walladhīna min qablihim kadhdhabū biyāti rabbihim faʾahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim waʾaghraqnā ʾāla firʿawna wakullun kānū ẓālimīn
ʾinna sharra d-dawābbi ʿinda llāhi ladhīna kafarū fahum lā yuʾminūn
Alladhīna ʿāhadtta minhum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fi kulli marratin wahum lā yattaqūn
Faʾimmā tathqafannahum fi l-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laʿallahum yadhdhakkarūn
Waʾimmā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānatan fanbidh ʾilayhim ʿalā sawāʾin ʾinna llāha lā yuḥibbu l-khāʾinīn
Walā yaḥsabanna ladhīna kafarū sabaqū ʾinnahum lā yuʿjizūn

Waʾaʿiddū lahum mā staṭaʿtum min quwwatin wamin ribāṭi l-khayli turhibūna bihi ʿaduwwa llāhi waʿaduwwakum waʾākharīna min dūnihim lā taʿlamūnahumu llāhu yaʿlamuhum wamā tunfiqū min shāʾin fi sabīli llāhi yuwaffa ʾilaykum waʾantum lā tuẓlamūn
Waʾin janaḥū lilssalmi fajnaḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalā llāhi ʾinnahu huwa s-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
Waʾin yurīdū ʾan yakhdaʿūka faʾinna ḥasbaka llāhu huwa ladhi ʾayyadaka binaṣrihi wabilmuʾminīn
Waʾallafa bayna qulūbihim law ʾanfaqta mā fi l-ʾarḍi jamīʿan mā ʾallafta bayna qulūbihim walākinna llāha ʾallafa baynahum ʾinnahu ʿazīzun ḥakīm
Yāʾayyuhā n-nabiyyu ḥasbuka llāhu wamani tabaʿaka mina l-muʾminīn

Yāʾayyuhā n-nabiyyu ḥarriḍi l-muʾminīna ʿalā l-qitāli ʾin yakun minkum ʿishrūna ṣābirūna yaghlibū miʾatayni waʾin yakun minkum miʾatun yaghlibū ʾalfan mina ladhīna kafarū biʾannahum qawmun lā yafqahūn
Alāna khaffafa llāhu ʿankum waʿalima ʾanna fīkum ḍaʿfan faʾin yakun minkum miʾatun ṣābiratun yaghlibū miʾatayni waʾin yakun minkum ʾalfun yaghlibū ʾalfayni biʾidhni llāhi walllahu maʿa ṣ-ṣābirīn
Mā kāna linabiyyin ʾan yakūna lahu ʾasrā ḥattā yuthkhina fi l-ʾarḍi turīdūna ʿaraḍa d-dunyā walllahu yurīdu lākhirata walllahu ʿazīzun ḥakīm
Lawlā kitābun mina llāhi sabaqa lamassakum fīmā ʾakhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīm
Fakulū mimmā ghanimtum ḥalālan ṭayyiban wattaqū llāha ʾinna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
Yāʾayyuhā n-nabiyyu qul liman fi ʾaydīkum mina l-ʾasrā ʾin yaʿlami llāhu fi qulūbikum khayran yuʾtikum khayran mimmā ʾukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum walllahu ghafūrun raḥīm
Waʾin yurīdū khiyānataka faqad khānū llāha min qablu faʾamkana minhum walllahu ʿalīmun ḥakīm

ʾinna ladhīna ʾāmanū wahājarū wajāhadū biʾamwālihim waʾanfusihim fi sabīli llāhi walladhīna ʾāwaw wanaṣarū ʾūlāʾika baʿḍuhum ʾawliyāʾu baʿḍin walladhīna ʾāmanū walam yuhājirū mā lakum min walāyatihim min shāʾin ḥattā yuhājirū waʾini stanṣarūkum fi d-dīni faʿalaykumu n-naṣru ʾillā ʿalā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun walllahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr
Walladhīna kafarū baʿḍuhum ʾawliyāʾu baʿḍin ʾillā tafʿalūhu takun fitnatun fi l-ʾarḍi wafasādun kabīr
Walladhīna ʾāmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fi sabīli llāhi walladhīna ʾāwaw wanaṣarū ʾūlāʾika humu l-muʾminūna ḥaqqan lahum maghfiratun warizqun karīm
Walladhīna ʾāmanū min baʿdu wahājarū wajāhadū maʿakum faʾūlāʾika minkum waʾūlū l-ʾarḥāmi baʿḍuhum ʾawlā bibaʿḍin fi kitābi llāhi ʾinna llāha bikulli shāʾin ʿalīm
